recommendations.reasoning: Delivers the smoky, iron-rich Syrah intensity you reach for in Northern Rhône. La Landonne is the most structured of Guigal's single-vineyard trio — full-bodied with the inky depth and violet perfume that defines your high-body, high-tannin preference markers.
recommendations.confidence: high — syrah top varietal, Northern Rhône top region, matches taste_markers exactly
recommendations.nose: Smoked meat, violet, and iron dust with blueberry and leather.
recommendations.palate: Full-bodied and dense with silky tannins, a core of dark fruit, and a 20-second finish.

recommendations.reasoning: A Northern Rhône Syrah at a more accessible price than La Landonne, with the same smoky, mineral profile that anchors your preferences. Unlike the extracted New World Shiraz you avoid, this is all restraint and terroir expression.
recommendations.confidence: high — top varietal and region, avoids avoided style
recommendations.nose: Black pepper, smoke, and olive with violet and dark plum.
recommendations.palate: Full-bodied with firm tannins, mineral freshness, and a long savory finish.

recommendations.reasoning: The most approachable of the three — a leaner Syrah that still delivers the Northern Rhône smoke-and-pepper signature at a friendlier price point, ideal as a second bottle or for a lighter course.
recommendations.confidence: medium — same style and region, but lighter frame may underserve the highest-body preference
recommendations.nose: Blueberry, pepper, and smoked meat with a lifted herbal note.
recommendations.palate: Medium-full body with peppery freshness, soft tannins, and a clean smoky finish.
